messages.subject: Posterior Predictive Checks
messages.body_plain:
Dear Prof. Ahn,

My Lab is using hBayesDM to fit some novel tasks. We appreciate very much your making the package available to the community.

Would you consider adding code to the Generated Quantities block of the model files, and add elements to the hBayesDM structure, so that users could easily plot posterior predictive checks on the ypred distributions, comparing them to measured y? This would assist model assessment.

Thank you very much.

Best wishes,

Michael Spezio, Ph.D.
Associate Professor of Psychology & Neuroscience
Laboratory for Inquiry into Valuation and Emotion
(The LIVE Lab)
Scripps College
120 Steele Hall
1030 Columbia Ave.
Claremont, CA 91711

messages.subject: Re: Adding new .stan model files?
messages.body_plain:
It's relatively straightforward to add new models (for us, developers), but I understand it's not that easy.. In a forthcoming manuscript with my student (Nate Haines), we plan to describe how to add new models in the appendix. Please stay tuned and thanks for your interests. If you have any models (codes) you want to be included in the hBayesDM package, please feel free to email us your codes and we can possibly add them to the package.

Best,
Young

messages.subject: Can't get stock example to run
messages.subject_clean: Can't get stock example to run
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am trying to run the example of delayed discounting data, but I can't seem to get it to work. When I run the example code as written

output <- dd_hyperbolic(data = "example", niter = 2000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 3, ncore = 3)

it starts to run correctly, but after it says building a model, please wait, it repeats "Warning (non-fatal): Comments beginning with # are deprecated.  Please use // in place of # for line comments." over and over.

When I import the txt file to R as a data frame or matrix it just says it is an invalid file argument.

I am at a loss as to why the stock example won't run. Anyone know why it might not be working, or why it won't accept a data frame? The other package I have running at the moment is rstanarm and its dependencies, but even after restarting R and just starting up the hBayesDM package the issue persists.

messages.subject: Re: Can't get stock example to run
messages.subject_clean: Can't get stock example to run
messages.body_plain:
We need to update the hBayesDM package so that '//' will be used instead of '#' for comments. Sorry for the inconvenience but these are just warning messages and models/codes should run without an error. FYI, I could run this code without a problem:

output <- dd_hyperbolic(data = "example", niter = 2000, nwarmup = 1000, nchain = 3, ncore = 3)

Please check if Stan is correctly installed and you may upload some sample data so that we can give it a try.

Best,
Young

Please check if Stan is correctly installed and you may upload some sample data so that we can give it a try.

Best,
